text:
Priya Singh: quick check — who can scribe/debrief for the 3:30 candidate today? need one person to capture scores + 2–3 bullets of takeaways. also want to confirm the eval protocol we use (weights + pass/fail thresholds).

Maya K: I can cover 3:30 scribe. do we want the usual 10min post-call buffer to collect notes? :memo:

Samir Patel: pinging to confirm: we agreed weighting is 60% technical, 25% system design, 15% culture/communication, right? and note whether we recommend takehome. also consent for recording? candidate already signed?

Elena Ortiz: weights look right to me. quick note on normalization — if two interviewers give outlier scores, we bias toward qualitative notes. suggest adding a single-line "confidence" field per scorer (low/med/high) so debrief lead can reconcile faster.

Priya Singh: candidate signed recording consent in calendar invite. Maya — please set a 10min buffer after the slot (we'll use it). add confidence field in the debrief form if possible.

Maya K: will do. where's the debrief form link? small fav: can we add the checkbox for "recommend next step" (yes / no / needs follow-up)?

Priya Singh: link: https://redwood-internal/sops/interview-debrief (use the "panel-debrief-v2" template). yes to checkbox — that helps hires team.

OpsBot: REMINDER: 3:20 — claim scribe for 3:30 panel: react with :hand: to confirm.

Samir Patel: small ask — if technical task got low score but system-design was strong, flag for follow-up interview rather than immediate reject. tag with #followup in the form.

Elena Ortiz: +1 on confidence field. quick rubric clarify: for culture we surface examples, not adjectives; please add 1–2 lines of behaviors observed.

Maya K: claimed as scribe :hand: Will add confidence & recommend checkbox, and tag option.

Priya Singh: perfect — I'll send a 5-min debrief template to panel after the call. thx everyone :pray:
